title: 第453章 快去救曹师兄吧第452章 难道就让他把人带走吗
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
那弟子扶着膝盖，喘了两口。
“曹师兄去了刘清河洞府。”
“刘长老像是早就在等他，还摆了酒。”
“开始好像还坐着喝了几碗。”
广场上的弟子听得一愣。
“喝酒？”
“抓人之前还喝酒？”
“曹师兄也太讲究了吧。”
赵奎眼皮一跳。“然后呢？”
那弟子声音更急。
“然后就打起来了！”
“刘长老祭出丹炉，大道火光铺满半山，洞府禁制都被打亮了。”
“曹师兄跟他打得很凶。”
“我离得远，只看见刘长老的洞府塌了半边。”
“后花园也没了。”
许柏吸了口气。“洞府都打烂了？”
赵奎迫切的问道。“结果呢？”
那弟子抬头。“刘长老被镇压了。”
执法堂前再次安静。
赵奎的手还抓着那弟子的肩膀，听到这句，力气都松了点。“啊？？？你再说一遍。”

那弟子咽了咽。“刘清河长老，被曹师兄镇压了。”
周围排队的弟子全傻了。
有人没控制住声音。
“不可能吧？”
“曹师兄不是才六品天尊吗？”
“刘清河长老可是八品天尊啊。”
“六品打八品？还赢了？”
“之前不是说曹师兄六品大圆满了吗？”
“六品大圆满也不对啊，那是八品天尊！”
一个外峰弟子抱着玉简，整个人都懵了。
“我前几天还见过刘长老炼丹，他抬手那火气，隔着好远都压得我走不动。”
“曹师兄居然把他镇压了？”
那报信弟子急得跺脚。
“我没有半句假话！”
“刘长老确实被镇压了。”
content_en:
The disciple held his knees and took a few breaths.
"Senior Brother Cao went to Liu Qinghe Cave Mansion."
"Elder Liu seems to have been waiting for him for a long time, and even set out wine."
"It seemed like I was sitting and drinking a few bowls at first."
The disciples in the square were stunned when they heard this.
"Drink?"
"Did you drink before arresting someone?"
"Senior Brother Cao is too particular."
Zhao Kui's eyelids twitched. "Then what?"
The disciple's voice became even more urgent.
"Then the fight started!"
"Elder Liu sacrificed the alchemy furnace, the avenue was covered with flames halfway up the mountain, and all the cave restrictions were illuminated."
"Senior Brother Cao fought him very hard."
"I was far away, and I only saw half of Elder Liu's cave collapsed."
"The back garden is gone too."
Xu Bai took a breath. "The cave has been smashed?"
Zhao Kui asked urgently. "What's the result?"
The disciple looked up. "Elder Liu was suppressed."
It was quiet again in front of the law enforcement hall.
Zhao Kui's hand was still holding the disciple's shoulder. Hearing this sentence, his strength relaxed a little. "Huh??? Say it again."
The disciple swallowed. "Elder Liu Qinghe was suppressed by Senior Brother Cao."
The disciples lining up around him were all dumbfounded.
Someone failed to control his voice.
"Isn't it possible?"
"Isn't Senior Brother Cao only a sixth-grade Tianzun?"
"Elder Liu Qinghe is an eighth-grade Heavenly Lord."
"Sixth level versus eighth level? You still won?"
"Didn't I say that Senior Brother Cao has reached the sixth level of Dzogchen before?"
"The sixth-grade Dzogchen is not right either, that is the eighth-grade Heavenly Lord!"
A disciple from the outer peak was holding the jade slip and was completely stunned.
"I saw Elder Liu refining elixirs a few days ago. The anger he raised his hands made me unable to move even from a distance."
"Senior Brother Cao actually suppressed him?"
The disciple who reported the news was so anxious that he stamped his feet.
"I didn't tell any lies!"
"Elder Liu was indeed suppressed."
